This is Godot theme made from Vertex gtk theme's textures.
With the custom theme i'm able to reproduce the crash, it's a regression from 4.7 beta 3. I'll bisect.

Its probably from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118865 where the `Ref<StyleBoxFlat> tab_style = get_theme_stylebox(SNAME("tab_selected"), "TabBar");` line is added.

Looks like its because it assumes it is a StyleBoxFlat when the theme uses StyleBoxTexture.
I'll make a PR.
